[[File:Cerimônia de comemoração pelos 55 anos aniversário do INPE. Foto Ricardo Fonseca - 29946794565.jpg|right|thumb|200px|Galvão and then minister [[Gilberto Kassab]] in 2016.]]
'''Ricardo Magnus Osório Galvão''' (born 21 December 1947) is a prominent Brazilian physicist and engineer, formerly the Director-General of the [[National Institute for Space Research]].<ref name=bbc/><ref name=Nom>{{cite web |title=Ricardo Galvão é nomeado diretor do INPE |access-date=21 December 2016 |url=http://www.inpe.br/noticias/noticia.php?Cod_Noticia=4280 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161222002347/http://www.inpe.br/noticias/noticia.php?Cod_Noticia=4280 |archive-date=2016-12-22 |url-status=live }}</ref><ref name="folha2016">{{cite web|url=http://www1.folha.uol.com.br/ciencia/2016/09/1815799-com-quatro-meses-de-atraso-governo-nomeia-novo-diretor-do-inpe.shtml|title=Com quatro meses de atraso, governo nomeia novo diretor do Inpe|publisher=Folha de São Paulo|access-date=21 December 2016|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161221235630/http://www1.folha.uol.com.br/ciencia/2016/09/1815799-com-quatro-meses-de-atraso-governo-nomeia-novo-diretor-do-inpe.shtml|archive-date=2016-12-21|url-status=live}}</ref> He is a full Professor of the Institute of Physics of the [[University of São Paulo]], member of the [[Brazilian Academy of Sciences]],<ref name="abc">{{cite web |url=http://www.abc.org.br/~rgalvao |title=Academia Brasileira de Ciências – Membros |access-date=21 December 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170427024246/http://www.abc.org.br/~rgalvao |archive-date=2017-04-27 |url-status=dead }}</ref> fellow of the [[Institute of Physics]] and councilman of the [[European Physical Society]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.eps.org/person/12414635/University-of-Sao-Paulo-Ricardo-M.O-Galvao.htm |title=EPS Member |access-date=21 December 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20161221234717/http://www.eps.org/person/12414635/University-of-Sao-Paulo-Ricardo-M.O-Galvao.htm |archive-date=2016-12-21 |url-status=live }}</ref> Galvão has occupied major positions within the Brazilian Physics community such as the presidency of the [[Brazilian Physical Society]] (2013–2016) and the directorship of the [[Brazilian Center for Research in Physics]] (2004–2011).<ref name="folha2016" /><ref name=Reu>{{cite web|url=http://www.sbfisica.org.br/atas/ata_da_reuniao_conselho_25_out_2013.pdf|title=Ata da Reunião de Conselho de 25 de outubro de 2013|publisher=SBF|access-date=1 August 2013|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150318052454/http://www.sbfisica.org.br/atas/ata_da_reuniao_conselho_25_out_2013.pdf|archive-date=2015-03-18|url-status=live}}</ref>

Galvão's research is primarily devoted to [[plasma physics]] and [[magnetic confinement fusion|thermonuclear magnetic fusion]]. He served as a board member for Plasma Physics and Controlled Fusion (1995–2005) and headed the Plasma Physics Laboratory of the University of São Paulo (2000–2016), where he oversaw the operation of the [[Tokamak Chauffage Alfvén Brésilien|TCABR tokamak]].<ref name=Tok>{{cite web |url=http://web.if.usp.br/tcabr/node/15 |title= TCABR – Laboratório de Física de Plasmas (LFP)}}</ref>

In August 2019, he was removed from his position as Director-General of the National Institute for Space Research, after a public disagreement with President [[Jair Bolsonaro]] over scientific data that showed a significant increase in deforestation in the [[Amazon rainforest]] since the latter took office.<ref name=bbc>[https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-49212115 Brazil deforestation row: Space research head Galvão out], BBC News, 2 August 2019</ref>

== Biography ==
He graduated in Telecommunications Engineering from [[Fluminense Federal University|Universidade Federal Fluminense]] in 1969. He obtained a master's degree in Electrical Engineering from the [[State University of Campinas]] in 1972 and a PhD in Plasma Physics from the [[Massachusetts Institute of Technology]] in 1976.<ref name="abc"/>

He was director of the [[Centro Brasileiro de Pesquisas Físicas|Brazilian Centre for Physics Research]] (CBPF) between 2004 and 2011 and president of the [[Brazilian Physical Society]] between 2013 and 2016.<ref name="folha2016"/><ref name=Reu/> A full professor at the University of São Paulo, Galvão is a researcher at the USP's Plasma Physics Laboratory, where he conducts research in the area of nuclear fusion with the [[Tokamak Chauffage Alfvén Brésilien|TCABR tokamak]].<ref name=Tok/>

He was a professor at Unicamp from 1971 to 1982 and at the [[University of São Paulo]] since 1983, where he is currently a full professor. In parallel, he also worked as a researcher for the [[Department of Aerospace Science and Technology|Aerospace Technical Centre]] from 1982 to 1986.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.inpe.br/institucional/quem_quem/arquivos/cv_diretor_ricardo_magnus_osorio_galvao.pdf|title= Ricardo Magnus Osorio Galvao |accessdate=2019-08-08|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20190808174415/http://www.inpe.br/institucional/quem_quem/arquivos/cv_diretor_ricardo_magnus_osorio_galvao.pdf|archivedate=2019-08-08|url-status=live}}</ref> In 1981 he also worked, inside USP, together with Ivan Nascimento, in the construction of TBR-1, the first tokamak in Latin America, which was functional until 1995.<ref>{{cite news|url=https://revistapesquisa.fapesp.br/en/ricardo-magnus-osorio-galvao-the-physicist-who-would-not-bend/|title=Ricardo Magnus Osório Galvão: The physicist who would not bend|date=July 2020|author=Marcos Pivetta|issue=293|journal=Fapesp|accessdate=2022-05-22}}</ref>

From 2005 to 2012 he was director of the [[Centro Brasileiro de Pesquisas Físicas|Brazilian Centre for Physics Research]] (CBPF).<ref>{{Cite web|title=Comportamento do governo é "obscurantista e autoritário", diz ex-diretor do Inpe|url=https://www.brasildefato.com.br/2019/09/02/comportamento-do-governo-e-obscurantista-e-autoritario-diz-ex-diretor-do-inpe|accessdate=2020-05-20|language=pt-BR|date=2019-09-02|work=Brasil de Fato|last=Eduardo Bernardes|first=José}}</ref>

In 2016 he took over as head of the [[National Institute for Space Research]].<ref name=Nom/><ref name="folha2016"/> Following his exoneration in 2019, Galvão returned to teaching at the [[Institute of Physics of the University of São Paulo|Institute of Physics]] at USP.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://revistatrip.uol.com.br/homenageados/2020/ricardo-galvao|title=Resistência ao negacionismo|year=2020|accessdate=2022-05-22|language=pt-br}}</ref>

==Awards==
In 1984 Galvão received the [[ICTP Prize]] from the [[International Centre for Theoretical Physics]] in Trieste, Italy, for his theoretical contributions in magnetohydrodynamic equilibrium and stability, resistive modes and laser interaction with matter.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.ictp.it/about-ictp/prizes-awards/the-ictp-prize/the-prize-winners/ictp-prize-winner-1984.aspx|title=ICTP Prize Winner 1984|date=1984|work=International Centre for Theoretical Physics|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20181026200747/https://www.ictp.it/about-ictp/prizes-awards/the-ictp-prize/the-prize-winners/ictp-prize-winner-1984.aspx|archivedate=2018-10-26}}</ref> In 2008 he was admitted to the Class of Commander of the [[National Order of Scientific Merit]]<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.sbfisica.org.br/v1/index.php?option=com_content&id=147|title=Sócios da SBF são admitidos na Ordem Nacional do Mérito Científico|date=2009|work=Sociedade Brasileira de Física|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20160303165557/http://www.sbfisica.org.br/v1/index.php?option=com_content&id=147|archivedate=2016-03-03|language=pt-br}}</ref> and in 2015 received the Carneiro Felippe Medal.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Entrega da Medalha Carneiro Felippe|url=http://agencia.fapesp.br/entrega-da-medalha-carneiro-felippe/21957/|work=Agência FAPESP|language=pt-br|date=2015-10-14|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20190722033339/http://agencia.fapesp.br/entrega-da-medalha-carneiro-felippe/21957/|archivedate=2019-07-22}}</ref>

==Friction with Jair Bolsonaro==
On Friday, 19 July 2019, the president [[Jair Bolsonaro]] publicly criticized Ricardo Galvão during a news conference with the international press, accusing him of giving lying data about [[Amazon rainforest|Amazon]] [[deforestation]] and being in the service of some NGO: "The issue of Inpe, I have the conviction that the data are liers. I even sent to see who is the guy who is in front of Inpe. He will have to come explain here in [[Brasília]] this data there that passed to the press worldwide, which our feeling does not match the truth. It even seems that he is at the service of some NGO, which is very common."<ref>{{cite web|title=Bolsonaro diz que diretor do INPE pode estar "a serviço de alguma ONG"|trans-title=Bolsonaro says INPE director may be "at the service of some NGO"|url=https://www.oeco.org.br/blogs/salada-verde/bolsonaro-diz-que-diretor-do-inpe-pode-estar-a-servico-de-alguma-ong/|date=19 July 2019|publisher=O Eco|last=Bragança|first=Daniele}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://sustentabilidade.estadao.com.br/noticias/geral,bolsonaro-acusa-inpe-de-divulgar-dados-mentirosos-sobre-desmatamento,70002929326|title=Bolsonaro acusa Inpe de divulgar dados mentirosos sobre desmatamento|trans-title=Bolsonaro accuses Inpe of disclosing lying deforestation data|access-date=8 August 2019 |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20190806004106/https://sustentabilidade.estadao.com.br/noticias/geral,bolsonaro-acusa-inpe-de-divulgar-dados-mentirosos-sobre-desmatamento,70002929326|archivedate=6 August 2019|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/ambiente/2019/07/bolsonaro-critica-diretor-do-inpe-por-dados-sobre-desmatamento-que-prejudicam-nome-do-brasil.shtml|title= Bolsonaro critica diretor do Inpe por dados sobre desmatamento que 'prejudicam' nome do Brasil|trans-title=Bolsonaro criticizes Inpe director for data on deforestation that 'harm' Brazil's name|access-date=8 August 2019 |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20190720150953/https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/ambiente/2019/07/bolsonaro-critica-diretor-do-inpe-por-dados-sobre-desmatamento-que-prejudicam-nome-do-brasil.shtml|archivedate=20 July 2019|url-status=live|date= 19 July 2019}}</ref> The Ministry of Science even built a group to survey Ricardo Galvão's life, in order to see any things he "did wrong," as a way to force him to resign, as well as having his phone tapped.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oeco.org.br/reportagens/o-inpe-esta-abandonado-diz-ricardo-galvao-ex-diretor-do-instituto/|title="O INPE está abandonado", diz Ricardo Galvão, ex-diretor do Instituto|date=2022-07-05|accessdate=2022-07-07|quote=“Professor, eu quero lhe dizer uma coisa, eu acabo de sair de uma reunião, eles montaram um grupo, inclusive com pessoas da área de Inteligência do governo, e estão fazendo um levantamento de toda sua vida para saber, pra ver as coisas que você fez de errado, para forçar o senhor a vir para Brasília se demitir. E quero dizer que tanto o seu telefone quanto seu e-mail estão grampeados”.|language=pt-br}}</ref>

On Saturday, Galvão countered the criticism made by the president:<ref>{{cite web|url=https://sustentabilidade.estadao.com.br/blogs/ambiente-se/bolsonaro-tomou-atitude-pusilanime-e-covarde-diz-diretor-do-inpe/|title=Bolsonaro tomou 'atitude pusilânime e covarde', diz diretor do |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20190726151732/https://sustentabilidade.estadao.com.br/blogs/ambiente-se/bolsonaro-tomou-atitude-pusilanime-e-covarde-diz-diretor-do-inpe/|archivedate=26 July 2019|url-status=live}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://jovempan.uol.com.br/noticias/brasil/inpe-rebate-bolsonaro-amazonia.html|title=Diretor do Inpe rebate fala de Bolsonaro sobre Amazônia: 'Ele |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20190722042139/https://jovempan.uol.com.br/noticias/brasil/inpe-rebate-bolsonaro-amazonia.html|archivedate=22 July 2019|url-status=live|date=20 July 2019}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.brasil247.com/brasil/bolsonaro-tomou-atitude-pusilanime-e-covarde-dispara-diretor-do-inpe|title=Bolsonaro tomou 'atitude pusilânime e covarde', dispara |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20190722042430/https://www.brasil247.com/brasil/bolsonaro-tomou-atitude-pusilanime-e-covarde-dispara-diretor-do-inpe|archivedate=22 July August 2019|url-status=live}}</ref>

{{blockquote|The first thing I can say is that mr. Jair Bolsonaro needs to understand that a [[President of the Republic]] cannot speak in public, especially at a press conference, as if he were in a [[botequim]] conversation. He made inappropriate and unsubstantiated comments and made unacceptable attacks not only on me, but on people working for the science of this country. He said he was convinced that Inpe's data are a lie. More than offensive to me, it was very offensive to the institution. (...) I was really upset, because in my opinion he played with me the same game he did with [[Joaquim Levy]] (who resigned from [[Brazilian Development Bank|BNDES]] after also being criticized in public by Bolsonaro). He has taken a pusillanimous, cowardly attitude to make a public statement perhaps hoping I will resign, but I will not. I hope he calls me to [[Brasília]] to explain the data and that he has the courage to repeat, looking face to face in my eyes. I am a 71-year-old gentleman, a member of the [[Brazilian Academy of Sciences]], I will not accept such an offense. He who has the courage to face up to what he is doing. It's a botequim offense. I will not answer him and he is the one who should call me personally and also should have the courage to tell me that face to face.|Ricardo Galvão|}}

2019|language=pt-BR|first=Vera|last=Batista}}</ref> and physicist [[Luiz Pinguelli Rosa]].<ref>{{Cite web|title=Pinguelli divulga carta em apoio a diretor do Inpe|trans-title=Pinguelli publishes letter in support of Inpe director|url=http://www.jb.com.br/pais/2019/07/1010723-pinguelli-divulga-carta-em-apoio-a-diretor-do-inpe.html|work=jb.com.br|date=22 July 2019|access-date=26 July 2019|language=pt-br}}</ref> Galvão reaffirmed his previous statements and although he would not respond to the note of minister [[Marcos Pontes]] for not knowing its content and would meet with the minister before replying. He further stated that he had already contacted the minister.<ref>{{Cite web|title='Não volto atrás em nenhuma vírgula no que eu disse', afirma diretor do Inpe|trans-title='I don't go back in any comma in what I said', says director of Inpe|url=https://oglobo.globo.com/sociedade/nao-volto-atras-em-nenhuma-virgula-no-que-eu-disse-afirma-diretor-do-inpe-23824766|work=O Globo|date=22 July 2019|access-date=26 July 2019|language=pt-BR}}</ref> On 7 August 2019, Ricardo Galvão's dismissal was published.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.atarde.uol.com.br/brasil/noticias/2081410-exoneracao-de-ricardo-galvao-do-inpe-e-publicada|title=Exoneração de Ricardo Galvão do Inpe é publicada|trans-title=Ricardo Galvão demissal from Inpe is published|access-date=7 August 2019 |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20190807145523/http://www.atarde.uol.com.br/brasil/noticias/2081410-exoneracao-de-ricardo-galvao-do-inpe-e-publicada|archivedate=7 August 2019|url-status=live}}</ref>

Douglas Morton, director of the Biosphere Sciences Laboratory at NASA's Space Flight Center, said INPE's results were "unquestionable," explained that INPE had always worked in a technical and judicious manner and classified Galvão's dismissal as significantly alarming and reflected as "current government treats science.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Demissão de chefe do Inpe é 'alarmante', diz diretor de centro da Nasa|trans-title=Resignation of Inpe's boss is 'alarming', says Nasa's center director|url=https://www.terra.com.br/noticias/ciencia/sustentabilidade/meio-ambiente/demissao-de-chefe-do-inpe-e-alarmante-diz-diretor-de-centro-da-nasa,efb19e0dcb6340488f6a4c2d64248c816en64goo.html|work=Terra|accessdate=2019-08-22|language=pt-BR}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|title=Demissão de chefe do Inpe é 'significativamente alarmante', diz diretor da Nasa|trans-title=Dismissal of Inpe's boss is 'significantly alarming', says Nasa director|url=https://epocanegocios.globo.com/Brasil/noticia/2019/08/demissao-de-chefe-do-inpe-e-significativamente-alarmante-diz-diretor-da-nasa.html|work=epocanegocios.globo.com|accessdate=2019-08-22|language=pt-br}}</ref> The official deforestation data issued by the Real-Time Deforestation Detection System (DETER) confirmed INPE's accuracy.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Balanços oficiais de desmatamento da Amazônia confirmam dados de sistema de alerta; entenda|trans-title=Official Amazon deforestation balance sheets confirm alert system data; understand|url=https://g1.globo.com/natureza/noticia/2019/08/18/balancos-oficiais-de-desmatamento-da-amazonia-confirmam-dados-de-sistema-de-alerta-entenda.ghtml|work=G1|date=18 August 2019 |accessdate=2019-08-22|language=pt-br}}</ref>

For his defence of science against Bolsonaro's attacks, the scientific journal [[Nature (journal)|Nature]] named Galvão as one of 2019's ten most important people in science.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|title=Nature's 10: Ten people who mattered in science in 2019|url=https://www.nature.com/articles/d41586-019-03749-0|work=www.nature.com|language=en|date=2019-12-17}}</ref><ref name=":2">{{Cite web|title=Ricardo Galvão, ex-presidente do Inpe, é escolhido um dos cientistas do ano|url=https://noticias.uol.com.br/meio-ambiente/ultimas-noticias/redacao/2019/12/13/ricardo-galvao-ex-presidente-do-inpe-e-escolhido-um-dos-cientistas-do-ano.htm|work=noticias.uol.com.br|language=pt-br|date=2019-12-13|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20191217170658/https://noticias.uol.com.br/meio-ambiente/ultimas-noticias/redacao/2019/12/13/ricardo-galvao-ex-presidente-do-inpe-e-escolhido-um-dos-cientistas-do-ano.htm|archivedate=2019-12-17}}</ref> In 2021 the [[American Association for the Advancement of Science]] awarded Galvão the Scientific Freedom and Responsibility Award.<ref name=":4">{{Cite web |last=Cohen |first=Adam D. |url=https://www.aaas.org/news/defense-amazon-deforestation-data-earns-2021-aaas-scientific-freedom-and-responsibility-award |title=Defense of Amazon Deforestation Data Earns 2021 AAAS Scientific Freedom and Responsibility Award |date=2021-02-08 |accessdate=2021-02-09 |website=American Association for the Advancement of Science |language=en |quote=The annual AAAS Scientific Freedom and Responsibility Award honors scientists who have demonstrated scientific freedom and/or responsibility in particularly challenging circumstances, sometimes at risk to their professional or physical safety. When Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro attacked the legitimacy of a report highlighting a dramatic increase in Amazon deforestation, Galvão stood behind the figures, a decision that cost him his job.}}</ref><ref name=":5">{{Cite web |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UEQ9kQSA3Rs |title=Physicist Honored for Defense of Deforestation Report |date=2021-02-10|work=wwwAAASorg |language=en |via=Youtube}}</ref>

== Political career ==

In 2022 Ricardo Galvão joined the [[Sustainability Network|REDE]] party<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://popularmais.com.br/noticia/10920/com-presenca-de-marina-silva-rede-filia-ricardo-galvao-e-outras-liderancas-em-evento-em-sao-paulo|title=Com presença de Marina Silva, Rede filia Ricardo Galvão e outras lideranças em evento em São Paulo|date=2022-03-27|accessdate=2022-05-22|language=pt-br}}</ref> with the goal of running for a seat as a federal deputy for [[São Paulo]] in the [[2022 São Paulo gubernatorial election#Chamber of Deputies|2022 elections]],<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://envolverde.com.br/ricardo-galvao-ex-diretor-do-inpe-lanca-sua-candidatura-a-deputado-federal-pela-rede-em-sao-paulo/|title=Ricardo Galvão, ex-diretor do INPE lança sua candidatura a Deputado Federal pela Rede, em São Paulo|date=2022-08-19|accessdate=2022-09-30|language=pt-br}}</ref> and received support from former President Lula.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://sampi.net.br/ovale/noticias/1720649/politica/2022/09/ricardo-galv-o-recebe-apoio-de-lula-em-evento-com-ex-presidenciaveis|title=Ricardo Galvão recebe apoio de Lula em evento com ex-presidenciáveis|date=2022-09-19|accessdate=2022-11-05|language=pt-br}}</ref> Galvão is also part of the Engaged Scientists movement.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/ciencia/2022/07/ex-reitores-de-universidades-tentam-criar-bancada-da-educacao-e-da-ciencia-no-congresso.shtml|title=Ex-reitores de universidades tentam criar bancada da educação e da ciência no Congresso|date=2022-07-28|accessdate=2022-09-30|language=pt-br}}</ref>

On October 2, 2022, Ricardo Galvão ran for federal deputy for the state of [[São Paulo (state)|São Paulo]], when he obtained 40,365 votes, a result that put him in third place in the party federation between REDE and [[PSOL]], behind the PSOL candidate [[Luciene Cavalcante]], first deputy with 49,131 votes, and the then federal deputy [[Ivan Valente]], second deputy with 44,424 votes.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://g1.globo.com/sp/sao-paulo/eleicoes/2022/apuracao/governador.ghtml|title=Eleições em São Paulo|work=[[G1 (website)|G1]]|access-date=2022-10-03|language=pt-br}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://oglobo.globo.com/blogs/miriam-leitao/post/2022/10/criticos-de-bolsonaro-ex-delegado-no-amazonas-e-ex-presidente-do-inpe-nao-sao-eleitos.ghtml|title=Críticos de Bolsonaro, ex-delegado no Amazonas e ex-presidente do Inpe não são eleitos|date=2022-10-03|accessdate=2022-10-03|language=pt-br}}</ref>

On November 16, 2022 Ricardo Galvão was announced by Vice President-elect [[Geraldo Alckmin]] as a member of the [[Second presidential transition of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva|transition team]] in the Environment portfolio of [[Second presidency of Lula da Silva|elected government]] in 2022.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.metropoles.com/brasil/ex-diretor-do-inpe-demitido-por-bolsonaro-integra-transicao-de-lula|title=Ex-diretor do Inpe demitido por Bolsonaro integra transição de Lula|date=2022-11-16|accessdate=2022-11-18}}</ref>

On January 13, 2023, after the inauguration of the government elected in 2022, Minister Luciana Santos decided to appoint Ricardo Galvão as president of [[CNPq]],<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www1.folha.uol.com.br/ciencia/2023/01/ricardo-galvao-ex-diretor-do-inpe-deve-assumir-presidencia-do-cnpq.shtml|title=Ricardo Galvão, ex-diretor do Inpe, deve assumir presidência do CNPq|language=pt-br|first=Giovana|last=Girardi|journal=Folha de São Paulo|date=2023-01-13|accessdate=2023-01-14}}</ref> being inaugurated on January 17.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://g1.globo.com/politica/noticia/2023/01/17/ricardo-galvao-assume-cnpq-e-diz-que-ciencia-sobreviveu-a-governo-negacionista-de-bolsonaro.ghtml|title=Ricardo Galvão assume CNPq e diz que ciência 'sobreviveu' a governo 'negacionista' de Bolsonaro|date=2023-01-17|accessdate=2023-01-18|language=pt-br}}</ref>

== Tribute ==
[[File:Diptychophora galvani holotype.png|thumb|''[[Diptychophora galvani]]'']]
The moth ''[[Diptychophora galvani]]'' Landry & Becker, 2021 is dedicated to Galvão, "for his courage in the face of professional adversity". The descriptors also suggest that "the orange colour of the moth's forewings are reminiscent of the devastating fires that had become more prevalent in the Amazon in 2019, compared to 2018, based on Dr Galvão and his team's scientific data that cost Dr Galvão his position of Director of the Brazilian National Institute for Space Research in August 2019".<ref>{{cite Q|Q107820343}}</ref>
